Line.DefaultText: Simple enough. Minted coin is scarce out here; what the village trusts is salt and metal. Salt, nuggets, coins: all of it spends. Leave a deposit with me and I'll keep you an account, meals and a warm bed drawn against it at fair rates. The Academy across the way runs the same: the Professor draws tuition from a lectern account for his courses. Earn, deposit, spend: that's the whole economy.

Answer.DefaultText: Anything around here I could help with?
